verdict.rationale: There is no first-party data-use or training opt-out policy in the evidence. Pipecat is a BSD-licensed, pip-installable framework that can be self-hosted, and community reports say it supports local inference (Ollama, custom OpenAI endpoints, local Whisper STT). That lets a user keep conversation data off third-party model providers, but only as an architectural workaround, not a documented guarantee. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy for Pipecat Cloud, documented training opt-out controls, first-party privacy or data-retention docs, independent corroboration.
